attchmntText: A-One Steels India Limited has informed the Exchange about the NCLT order approving the Scheme of Amalgamation
voiceSummary: A-One Steels India Limited received NCLT Hyderabad Bench orders on November 20, 2026, regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation with subsidiaries M/s Basai Steels and Power Private Limited and M/s A-One Gold Pipes and Tubes Private Limited. The Tribunal allowed the Company Petition CP CAA No. 30/230/HDB/2026, sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation with an Appointed Date of October 1, 2025. The Interlocutory Application IA CAA No. 150/2026 filed by shareholder Mr. K. Ravi Shankar was dismissed as not maintainable.

attchmntText: A-One Steels India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Reporting of violation related to Code of Conduct under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015'.
voiceSummary: A-One Steels India Limited reported violations of the Code of Conduct under SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. Designated Person Aftab Alam, Shift Incharge, sold 37 equity shares for Rs. 15,821.41 on November 12, 2026, during the closed trading window. The company issued a strict written warning to him. Designated Person S Rajpal Singh, Assistant Manager, sold 37 equity shares for Rs. 15,693.95 on November 11, 2026, during the closed trading window. The company issued a written warning to him. Both individuals acknowledged the inadvertent contravention, citing urgent personal financial needs. They confirmed no possession of unpublished price-sensitive information. No previous violations or monetary penalties were recorded.

attchmntText: A-One Steels India Limited has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: A-One Steels India Limited intimates that the National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru Bench, recorded the full settlement of proceedings C.P. (IB)/34/BB/2026 via an order dated November 06, 2026. The Company paid the total settlement amount of Rs. 3,80,00,000/- in two equal installments of Rs. 1,90,00,000/- each to Operational Creditor Shri Khatu Shyam Ispat Udyog LLP. The Creditor filed a Withdrawal Memo Reporting Settlement on November 11, 2026, requesting the petition be treated as withdrawn. The matter is listed on November 30, 2026, for formal disposal by the Tribunal. The Company states that except for the payment of the settlement amount, there is no material adverse impact on its financial position.
